en.t: The car came up in front of Komako.

units.source_text: 只见驹子刚闭了闭眼睛，冷不防地向汽车扑上来。

en.t: Komako had only just closed her eyes for a moment when she suddenly lunged toward the car.

units.source_text: 车子没有停下，仍按原先的慢速爬上了坡道。

en.t: The car did not stop, but kept climbing the slope at the same slow pace as before.

units.source_text: 驹子弓着腰，抓住车门上的把手，跳到车门外的踏板上。

en.t: Komako bent at the waist, grabbed the handle on the car door, and jumped onto the step outside it.
